candidates.statement: The report did not restate already-held faltering-growth indicator-base conflict, chart-dependent threshold binding, and the preterm/VLBW corrected-age branch.
candidates.quote: The rows below are net-new candidate patterns aligned to the requested angles. I did not restate the already-held areas you said are already covered: faltering-growth indicator-base conflict, chart-dependent threshold binding, and the preterm/VLBW corrected-age branch.

candidates.statement: No independently retrievable public-domain or open-access numeric downward-height-percentile-line trigger matching the NICE parent-centile-distance trigger was found.
candidates.quote: I did not find an independently retrievable public-domain or open-access **numeric downward-height-percentile-line trigger** for short-stature work-up that matched the way NICE gives a parent-centile-distance trigger; the open sources I found were either narrative or institutional rather than a single public guideline table.

candidates.statement: No official CDC or WHO numeric BMI-percentile trajectory-crossing cut-off analogous to the category thresholds was found.
candidates.quote: I did not find an official CDC or WHO **numeric BMI-percentile trajectory-crossing cut-off** analogous to the category thresholds above; the public guideline sources were strong on category boundaries and chart-selection thresholds, but not on a canonical percentile-crossing rule.

candidates.statement: For Nellhaus raw chart-table thresholds, the original 1968 Pediatrics article is rights-restricted/paywalled and raw chart values were not extracted.
candidates.quote: For **Nellhaus raw chart-table thresholds**, the original 1968 *Pediatrics* article is rights-restricted/paywalled, so I did not extract raw chart values from the original source. I used open secondary sources for older-child chart selection and one study-specific Nellhaus percentile criterion instead.

candidates.statement: INTERGROWTH-21st preterm corrected-age thresholds were not re-extracted because the prompt marked that branch already held and out of scope for re-derivation.
candidates.quote: I did not re-extract **INTERGROWTH-21st preterm corrected-age thresholds** because your prompt explicitly marked the preterm/VLBW corrected-age branch as already held and out of scope for re-derivation.
